title: Structured Intake: Sales/CS Feature Request Unification & Quick-Feasibility Canvas
creator: Samira O'Connell
description:
Problem:
Sales and Customer Success submit enterprise feature requests in multiple places (email, notes, ad-hoc docs, demo recordings). That fragmentation leads to duplicated asks, inconsistent context, and slow first-pass feasibility checks.

Goal:
Create a lightweight, repeatable canvas + intake flow that standardizes: 1) minimal context capture, 2) impact & implementation banding, 3) first-pass econ estimate, and 4) routing for engineering/PM follow-up. The flow should be usable during a 10–20 minute CS or sales touch (not a formal requirements session).

Success metrics (first 90 days):
- Median first-pass triage time <= 48 hours from submission.
- % of enterprise asks labeled with implementation band (quick, medium, heavy) >= 85%.
- Reduction in duplicate asks surfaced during weekly reviews by 40%.

Approach / Proposed Canvas:
- Header (customer, account tier, ARR band, contact)
- Problem statement (1–2 sentences), example flows/screenshots link
- Customer benefit & key success metric they care about
- Must-have vs nice-to-have bullets (max 3 each)
- First-pass econ proxy: rough user counts, frequency, revenue/retention impact (tickboxes)
- Implementation band: Quick (UI config / toggle), Medium (API + console change), Heavy (runtime/model/infra work)
- Privacy/regulatory flags (PII, data residency, audit)
- Suggested SLA / deployment preference (hosted/dedicated/private)
- Primary owner for follow-up (Sales/CS/PM/Eng)

Integration points:
- Form should populate a Linear ticket (PM- key) with canonical fields and attach transcript/recording link when available.
- Quick de-dup check using account + short problem hash, surfaced in the intake UI.
- Slack/Drive templates for when request originates outside the form.

Acceptance criteria:
- Prototype canvas implemented as a Google Form + short Zapier workflow to create tickets (alpha)
- Linear ticket template populated with canonical fields and label set (sales-cs, enterprise-intake)
- Triage rubric documented: how to decide implementation band and econ proxy guidance
- Playbook doc (1–2 pages) for CS & sales to run intake in a customer call

Risks & open questions:
- Econ proxy accuracy: tension between speed and over-committing; need boundaries for when to escalate to a formal discovery.
- Ownership of follow-up: when does PM/Eng commit to a scoping session vs observational note-taking?
- Integrations: legal review for attaching call recordings to tickets (privacy).

Artifacts / Links:
- Mock canvas (Drive): https://drive.google.com/mock/canvas-intake-alpha
- Zapier prototype: https://zapier.com/links/redwood-intake-alpha
- Prior related ticket for reference: PM-271300

Next steps (short-term):
1) Run two live alpha intake sessions with 1 account each led by Solutions Engineer + PM (week 1)
2) Iterate form fields and econ proxy after alpha calls (week 2)
3) Launch internal playbook and Slack shortcut for intake (week 3)

Longer-term:
- Build a lightweight web intake (internal) that does de-dup, quick scoring, auto-routing and stores canonical fields for downstream analytics and Optimize recommendations.
